capacity.description: The capacity of the system, in Watts.

azimuth.description: The angle (degrees) from true north that the PV system is facing, if tilted.  Must be between -180 and 180.  An azimuth of 0 means the system is facing true north.

install_date.description: The date (YYYYMMMDD) of installation of the PV system.  We use this to estimate your loss factor based on ageing of your system.  If you provide a loss_factor this date will be ignored.

loss_factor.description: A factor by which to reduce your output forecast fom the full capacity based on characteristics of the PV array or inverter.

tilt.description: The angle (degrees) that the PV system is tilted off the horizontal.  Must be between 0 and 90. A tilt of 0 means that it is facing directly upwards, and 90 means the system is vertical and facing the horizon.
